  "concordance_definition": "The study defines concordance based on the similarity of gene set enrichment between human and mouse datasets, particularly focusing on shared or distinct biological processes identified through methods like Leading Edge Metagene (LEM) analysis. High overlap in gene sets or metagenes between species indicates concordance.",
  "limitations_stated": [
    "The degree to which mouse models can recapitulate events occurring in immunologic disease states in humans remains controversial.",
    "Contradictory findings have been reported in the comparison of gene expression across a range of human and mouse tissues.",
    "Whether the observed differences in transcriptional signatures are due to inherent biological differences between species remains unclear.",
    "The exact timing of the initiation of activation of immune cells in humans with sepsis is not precisely known and might be more variable compared to tightly controlled, narrow window of induction of sepsis in mouse models."
  ],
  "funding_conflict": null,
  "key_numbers": [
    "ImmuneSigDB: Collection of ~5,000 gene sets derived from ~400 immunological studies",
    "ImmuneSigDB included data from healthy human subjects, patients with immune or non-immune diseases, and mouse models.",
    "Mapped orthologous genes to a common identifier allowed inclusion of both human (n = 135) and mouse (n = 254) studies.",
    "From these studies, 2,436 meaningful comparisons and extracted 4,872 gene sets of up- or downregulated genes comprising the ImmuneSigDB.",
    "Analysis of sepsis response in human (six comparisons) and mouse (four comparisons) datasets found coordinate upregulation of metagenes involved in interferon-response and phagocytic processes.",
    "Mitosis metagene was much more specific to human datasets with no significant overlap in mouse studies.",
    "Phagocytic vesicle metagene was present or strongly overlapped with a metagene present in every dataset, both mouse and human.",
    "Analysis of 389 published studies of mouse and human immune cells to generate a collection of curated gene signatures.",
    "A small subset of gene sets in ImmuneSigDB and MSigDB were highly similar (0.64% of gene sets with p < 10-8).",
    "1.46% of gene sets with p < 10-8 had significant overlap within ImmuneSigDB.",
    "Only a small fraction of ImmuneSigDB gene sets significantly overlapped with Chaussabel (0.06%) or Li (0.18%) collections.",
    "Marked similarity in ImmuneSigDB gene sets enriched in human and mouse sepsis response (p = 5.01 x 10^-69).",
    "Leading edges of gene sets enriched in both species were similar (Spearman r = 0.857, p < 0.0001).",
    "LEM analysis of human sepsis (316 gene sets) and mouse sepsis (974 gene sets) identified three metagenes in each.",
    "Phagocytic vesicle metagene correlated with both human and mouse sepsis response (hypergeometric test p = 1.09 x 10^-31).",
    "Inflammatory response metagene in human dataset and TRIF-mediated TLR signaling in mouse model showed significant overlap (p = 2.79 x 10^-23)."
  ]
